ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/dark brown) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone at the fluke-peduncle junction. Lobes are predominantly high-intensity. Left lobe contains a high density of small, discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (speckling). Right lobe contains larger, irregular low-intensity patches primarily along the lower margin and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle estimated at 45 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably sharper jaggedness observed on the distal third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex upward curve from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, circular low-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the high-intensity background of both lobes, particularly concentrated in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, low-intensity linear streaks present on the high-intensity region of the right lobe lobe, appearing as three sub-parallel lines.
